text: In China, the School of International Education of UIBE leads the launch of the Chinese language training program, “Intensive Chinese”, which is elaborately designed for the students who hope to improve their Chinese proficiency rapidly in a short amount of time. Training objective: For the students who hope to improve their Chinese proficiency rapidly in a short time. Training goals: With the high intensive training, scientific curriculum, and flexible supplementary means after class, students can make great progress in their ability to listen, to speak, to read and to write in Chinese. Teaching method: To allow students to study both in ordinary and tutorial classes, to combine group class teaching with individual teaching, to give classroom instruction with extracurricular activities (debating, internship, speaking competition, travel, etc.) Term set: The program lasts 16 weeks within one semester, and classes are held for 30 hours each week. (In addition, the teachers instruct students to review and preview their study) Compulsory course: Include Discussion on Social Hot Topics, Business Newspaper Reading, Commercial Conversation, and Training Course for HSK Test, etc. Management method: this program adopts close relation's management method, avoids the mother tongue disturbance, help students achieve Chinese study goal as soon as possible. Application Period · April – August 31st for Fall Semester · October – November 30 for Spring Semester: Tuition Fee · Intensive Chinese: CNY 19,800/person for first semester and CNY 18,800/person for each subsequent semester. · Advance payment of CNY 3,000/person for Intensive Chinese, pays in full when confirmation enrollment, will be account into the total tuition fee and is not refundable after the opening of the semester. Certificate · Students who have completed all the courses and passed all the course examinations will be granted a certificate of completion
